text:
claire: Hey team, flying into Seattle for a workshop Thu. Staying near Pioneer Square. Any quick lunch recos for a solo afternoon meet-and-greet around 12:30? Prefer seafood or something with good takeout for walking.

ben: Pike Place is classic but can be slow. For quick seafood, Elliott's Oyster House is great but might be pricey.

arjun: If you want fast and local, I love The Pink Door for a sit-down vibe (but could be crowded). For takeout, Ivar's has reliable fish & chips stands.

megan: For something really quick, Jack's Fish Spot by the market is fast and solid. Also Beecher's has good mac & cheese if someone wants comfort food.

claire: Any spots that are friendly for solo diners and not too loud for a quick call after eating?

ben: Beecher's has counter seating so you can multitask. Etta's (nearby) is chill, good for solo folks.

arjun: Quick poll: :oyster: Elliott's/Etta's (sit, seafood), :fish_cake: Ivar's/Jack's (fast seafood/takeout), :cheese: Beecher's (comfort/counter), :sandwich: Pike Place sandwiches (market stalls)

megan: :fish_cake:

ben: :oyster: (but if time is tight, go fish_cake)

claire: Leaning takeout so I can walk to the venue and eat on a bench. Locking in Ivar's/Jack's for 12:30 unless anyone objects.

ops-bot: calendar: Event created "Pioneer Square Lunch  Claire" Thu 12:30-13:15 provisional. Attendees: claire.

claire: Thanks! Quick addresses to pin: ```Ivar's Seafood - 1001 Alaskan Way, Seattle, WA
Jack's Fish Spot - 1519 Pike Pl, Seattle, WA
Beecher's Handmade Cheese - 1600 Pike Pl, Seattle, WA```

megan: If you want a quieter post-lunch call, try the little green space near the Upward Projects building, benches and quieter on weekdays.

arjun: Also FYI PT boat tours nearby might make crowds weird during lunch hours, so heads up if you prefer calmer sidewalks.

claire: Great tip. Appreciate all the recs and the quick poll. See you Seattle folks! :airplane:
